lapAnalysis.title: Lap-time evolution
lapAnalysis.bestMarkers: Dots mark each driver/car's personal best lap.
lapAnalysis.sampled: Long lap histories are sampled for display; personal-best laps remain visible.
lapAnalysis.leadCaveat: Only leaders supported by saved lap crossings are shown. Timestamps are recorded at database write time, not by the CU; positions between crossings are unknown.
lapAnalysis.uncertain: Lead changes cannot be reliably reconstructed: missing, duplicate, simultaneous or unassigned laps.
lapAnalysis.noLeader: No leader established by recorded laps yet.
lapAnalysis.noChanges: No further lead changes established by logged laps.

printResults.title: Result sheet
printResults.lanHint: Intended for the local network, not automatically published on the internet. On another device, use the computer's LAN address instead of localhost.
printResults.onlyFinished: Printable results are available only for finished races and qualifying sessions.
printResults.classificationNote: Classification uses recorded laps, lap and time penalties, plus virtual tyre-adjusted time when enabled.

form.name: Name
form.driverRequired: At least one complete driver is required (driver, car, controller)
form.weatherHint: The same seed and weather time produce the same weather. CU settings and vehicle speed are unaffected.
form.weatherInvalid: Invalid weather: chance 0–100%, interval 10–3600 s, seed 0–2147483647.
form.tyreHint: Optional virtual lap-time factor. Dry tyres in rain or wet tyres on a dry track add time; measured laps and CU vehicle speed remain unchanged.
form.tyreInvalid: Tyre penalty must be 0–30% and requires enabled weather.
form.virtualFuelInvalid: Virtual consumption must be between 1 and 100% per minute.
form.virtualFuelHint: Software calculation: measured lap duration × rate / 60 seconds. Each car starts at 100%. Only confirmed simulator pit stops refuel automatically. CU fuel readings remain unchanged.
form.damageEnabled: Enable damage from abnormally slow laps
form.damageHint: Races only. One valid lap above the threshold triggers a single damage episode. Pauses freeze the deadline. Simulator pit intervals can auto-repair; real CU stops require director confirmation. No CU commands.
form.damageInvalid: Invalid values: threshold 1–600 s, deadline 5–3600 s, pit interval 1–300 s and not longer than the deadline.

pitStatus.title: Pit stops & virtual fuel
pitStatus.note: Only saved, completed pit cycles are counted. CU pit signals do not prove refuelling; virtual fuel does not program the CU.
pitStatus.refilled: Virtual tank refilled to {{percent}} % at this event.

requiredPits.note: Only completed simulator stops count. CU observations remain separate; this display does not automatically change classification.

lapFuel.title: Virtual tank before / after lap
lapFuel.note: Reconstructed from the saved fuel log; not CU measurements. Without a matching lap event, the history remains unknown.
